pain_assessment: QUESTT: question the patient; use an age- and developmentally appropriate pain-rating scale; evaluate behaviour and physiological changes; secure parental involvement if the patient is a child; take the cause of pain into account; take action and evaluate the response.
Pain score interpretation: 0 no pain; 1-3 mild pain; 4-6 moderate pain; 7-10 severe pain.

management_steps.details: Glucose 25% oral solution: 2 mL PO. Paracetamol oral: children 20 mg/kg PO STAT; adults 1.5 g PO STAT. Maximum dosing: birth-2 months 60 mg/kg/day divided TDS/QID; older than 2 months 90 mg/kg/day, maximum 4 g/day; adults 1 g PO QID. Paracetamol rectal: children 15-20 mg/kg PR STAT. Ibuprofen: children and adults 10 mg/kg PO STAT, then 5-10 mg/kg PO TDS with food. Mefanamic acid: children 6.5-7.5 mg/kg PO STAT; children 6 months-2 years 125 mg PR STAT; adults 500 mg PO STAT. Diclofenac: adults over 50 kg 75 mg IMI; off-label IV 1 mg/kg diluted in 5 mL/kg crystalloid and administered slowly.

Use medication for mild pain and consider one additional option. Tramadol oral 0.5-1 mg/kg STAT or IV/IO 1-1.5 mg/kg; maximum 8 mg/kg/day and 400 mg/day. Myprodol: adults 2 capsules STAT; children 3-5 years 5 mL PO STAT; children 6-12 years 10 mL PO STAT.

Perfalgan IV/IO: younger than 1 month 10 mg/kg STAT; older than 1 month 15 mg/kg STAT; adults 1 g IVI. Fentanyl IV/IO 1-1.5 µg STAT; intranasal atomised 1-2 µg/kg STAT; transmucosal 10-15 µg/kg. Morphine IV/IO 0.1-0.15 mg/kg; IM under 50 kg 0.1 mg/kg STAT, over 50 kg 0.1-0.2 mg/kg STAT; oral 0.25-0.5 mg/kg. Meperidine IMI under 50 kg 1 mg/kg STAT; adults over 50 kg 75-100 mg IMI STAT; IV/IO 0.25-0.5 mg/kg. Ketamine analgesic doses: IV/IO 0.25 mg/kg STAT (range 0.1-0.3 mg/kg); IM 1-2 mg/kg; oral 1-2 mg/kg; rectal 1-2.5 mg/kg; intranasal atomised 1.5-2.5 mg/kg.

warnings: Only one NSAID is to be used.
Ibuprofen, mefanamic acid and diclofenac are contraindicated in pregnancy.
Diclofenac is contraindicated in acute kidney injury, polytrauma and hypotension.
Tramadol is highly emetogenic and lowers the seizure threshold.
Morphine syrup: caution in very small infants; apnoea is a real risk.
protocol.note: Route-specific paracetamol doses are retained separately from the source table: oral 20 mg/kg STAT and rectal 15-20 mg/kg STAT.
